ya10.3.4:1.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānāti, so domanassind. pajahitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.4:2.1: Yo v. p. domanassind. pajahittha, so cakkhund. parijānātīti?
ya10.3.4:3.1: Dve puggalā domanassind. pajahittha, no ca cakkhund. parijānanti; aggamaggasamaṅgī domanassindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:4.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānāti, so anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.4:5.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha . . . Pañca
ya10.3.4:6.1: puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, no ca cakkhund. parijānanti; aggamaggasamaṅgī anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:7.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānāti, so aññind. bhāvitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.4:8.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvittha . . . No.
ya10.3.4:9.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānāti, so aññātāvind. sacchikaritthāti? No.
ya10.3.4:10.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarittha . . . No.
ya10.3.4:11.1: Yo domanassind. pajahati, so anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.4:12.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, so domanassind. pajahatīti?
ya10.3.4:13.1: Tayo puggalā anaññātaññassamītind. bhāvittha, no ca domanassind. pajahanti; anāgāmimaggasamaṅgī anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:14.1: Yo domanassind. pajahati, so aññind. bhāvitthāti? No.
ya10.3.4:15.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvittha, so domanassind. pajahatīti? No.
ya10.3.4:16.1: Yo domanassind. pajahati, so aññātāvind. sacchikaritthāti? No.
ya10.3.4:17.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarittha . . . No.
ya10.3.4:18.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāveti, so aññind. bhāvitthāti? No.
ya10.3.4:19.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvittha . . . No. Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāveti, so aññātāvind. sacchikaritthāti? No. Yo. v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarittha. . . No. Yo aññind. bhāveti, so aññātāvind. sacchikaritthāti? No. Yo v. p. aññātāvind., sacchikarittha so aññind. bhāvetīti? No. 8.
ya10.3.4:25.1: Anāgāmī cakkhund. na parijānāti, no ca domanassind. nappajjahittha; pañca puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca na parijānanti; domanassindriyañ ca napajahittha.
ya10.3.4:26.1: Yo vā pana domanassind. nappajahittha, so cakkhund. na parijānātīti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.4:27.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānāti, so anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvitthā ti?
ya10.3.4:28.1: Pañca puggalā cakkhund. na parijānanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha; dve puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:29.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha . . . Āmantā.
ya10.3.4:30.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānāti, so aññind. na bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.4:31.1: Āmantā. Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvittha . . . Āmantā.
ya10.3.4:34.1: na parijānāti, so aññātāvind. na sacchikaritthāti?
ya10.3.4:35.1: Arahā cakkhund. na parijānāti, no ca aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha; aṭṭha puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:36.1: Yo. v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha . . .
ya10.3.4:37.1: Aggamaggasamaṅgī aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha, no ca cakkhund. na parijānāti; aṭṭha puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarittha, cakkhundriyañ ca na parijānanti.
ya10.3.4:38.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahati, so anaññātaññassāmītind na bhavitthāti?
ya10.3.4:39.1: Cha puggalā domanassind. nappajahanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha; dve puggalā domanassindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:40.1: Yo v. p. anāññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha . . . Āmantā.
ya10.3.4:41.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahati, so aññind. na bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.4:42.1: Arahā domanassind. nappajahati, no ca aññind. na bhāvittha; satta puggalā domanassindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:43.1: Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvittha . . .
ya10.3.4:44.1: Anāgāmimaggasamaṅgī aññind. na bhāvittha, no ca domanassind. nappajahati; satta puggalā aññindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:45.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahati so aññātāvind. na sacchikaritthāti?
ya10.3.4:46.1: Arahā domanassind. nappajahati, no ca aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha; aṭṭha puggalā domanassindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:47.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha . . .
ya10.3.4:48.1: Anāgāmimaggasamaṅgī aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha, no ca domanassind. nappajahati; aṭṭha puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:49.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāveti, so aññind. na bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.4:50.1: Dve puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāventi, no ca aññind. na bhāvittha; satta puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca.
ya10.3.4:51.1: Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvittha . . .
ya10.3.4:52.1: Aṭṭhamako aññind. na bhavittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāveti; satta puggalā aññindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:53.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāveti. so aññātāvind. na sacchikaritthāti?
ya10.3.4:54.1: Arahā anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāveti, no ca aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha; aṭṭha puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:55.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha . . .
ya10.3.4:56.1: Aṭṭhamako aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāveti; aṭṭha puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.4:57.1: Yo aññind. na bhāveti, so aññātāvind. na sacchikaritthāti?
ya10.3.4:58.1: Arahā aññind. na bhāveti, no ca aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha; aṭṭha puggalā aññindriyañ ca . .
ya10.3.4:59.1: .Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha . . . Aggamaggasamaṅgī aññātāvind.
ya10.3.4:60.1: na sacchikarittha, no ca aññind. na bhāveti; aṭṭha puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarittha, aññindriyañ ca na bhāventi. 9.
